verdict.rationale: Alma's own content references government-sourced figures: it publishes a '4-6 months USCIS Processing Time' benchmark on its O-1A page and a dated International Entrepreneur Rule explainer citing the H.R. 1 parole fee change. The evidence shows no source links, USCIS data citations or FOIA statistics backing these claims, and its headline approval rate rests on internal case data rather than government data. Missing for 10: explicit links to USCIS processing-time data or policy sources, FOIA statistics, documented citation practice across guides, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer evaluating providers, the provider grounds its public claims in government data — USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or official policy citations with links

citations.quote: including the October 16, 2025 $1,000 H.R. 1 parole fee change
